description: This Java source file defines an Android Fragment class that renders PDF pages using PdfRenderer. It manages loading a PDF from assets, navigating between pages, and displaying pages in an ImageView.

classes.name: PdfRendererBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays PDF pages using PdfRenderer, with UI controls to navigate between pages.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, restores page state, and sets up click handlers.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Opens the PDF renderer when the fragment is attached to an activity.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Closes the PDF renderer when the fragment is detached.

methods.name: openRenderer
methods.description: Prepares the PdfRenderer by copying PDF asset to cache and opening the file.

methods.name: closeRenderer
methods.description: Closes the PdfRenderer and current page.

methods.name: showPage
methods.description: Displays the specified page of the PDF.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Updates navigation buttons and activity title based on current page.

methods.name: getPageCount
methods.description: Returns total number of pages in the PDF.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles navigation button clicks to move between PDF pages.
